routes.mechanism: Automatic erasure of certain cannabis possession convictions

timing.anchorText: No participant waiting period or filing. Section 54-142u concerns § 21a-279(c) possession convictions entered on or after 2000-01-01 and before 2015-10-01; this route identity does not establish that a particular conviction or every count qualifies.

requiredFacts: On what date was the cannabis possession conviction entered?
Which statute section were you convicted under?
How many counts are on this docket, and is every one of them erasable?
exclusions: Records referencing more than one count unless every count is entitled to erasure. § 54-142u(b).
Convictions outside the § 54-142u window belong to the separate cannabis petition mechanism; this route does not decide that petition.

commercialPosture.note: No participant filing or paid packet on the automatic mechanism.

routes.notes: E4-R2 exact-key successor to the historical LD-CT-02 current binding only. No participant filing, venue, service, signature or fee. Exact statute, conviction date and every-count eligibility remain unestablished until the actual record facts are supplied through a supported consumer; a hint, generic disposition, missing fact or this contract does not declare individual eligibility, actual erasure or record clearance. Reuse existing ct-cannabis-auto guidance. Internal criminal-justice-agency copies need not be partially redacted and DMV records need not be erased, §§ 54-142u(f)-(g); legal effect is subject to § 54-142u(h). Preserve immigration and records-not-erased-when-expected help boundaries. Separate § 54-142v route/family and § 54-142d mechanism remain distinct.
